PHYSICS CHECK  
USER CONSTRAINT: Governing relation: Volumetric efficiency η = Q_actual / Q_theoretical, where Q_theoretical = V_d × N (displacement × speed). Internal slip ΔQ = Q_theoretical - Q_actual ∝ (P_discharge - P_suction) / μ (viscosity).  
CALCULATED: At 40 bar (4 MPa) and 60 cSt (6×10⁻⁵ Pa·s), ΔQ ∝ 4e6 / 6e-5 = 6.67e10 m³/s per unit wear gap. Hysteresis area ∝ ΔQ × ΔP, growing linearly with wear.  
CALCULATED: 8% efficiency loss (Δη = 0.08) corresponds to ΔQ = 0.08 × Q_theoretical. For a 100 cm³/rev pump at 1500 RPM, Q_theoretical = 2.5 L/s, so ΔQ = 0.2 L/s.
